items.line: 12-a-side team matchplay (fourball/foursomes/singles) runs Thu-Sun. Brandt Snedeker's US side is favored, but Geoff Ogilvy's International team has major winners Scott, Matsuyama and Fox — decisive singles session is Sunday.
